encounter: E0146 TRAINER_KEEGAN, Lavaridge Gym room 2, cap 36
availability_audit: Chronology: Lavaridge Gym sits at the end of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney raised the cap; C23 is Flannery). Every member's source map precedes Lavaridge Town in book play order: Route 103 (C02), Petalburg City ponds and Route 102/104 (C02-C05), Granite Cave and Altering Cave rock smash (C12 + Rock Smash license from C18 Mauville), Mauville Game Corner (C18). No Surf-gated water (C27), no Strength-gated area (granted only after Flannery), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36.
plan: Same rain core. Against Guts Flareon and Choice Band Emboar, Gyarados's Intimidate and Garganacl's Purifying Salt (burn immunity) carry the physical side; Pelipper's rain halves every Fire attack; Togekiss redirects the single-target Fighting and Electric coverage away from Gyarados.

party.role: rain setter and speed control; Weather Ball becomes a 100-BP rain-boosted Water attack
party.availability: Wingull on Route103 land table (gate 14), evolves to Pelipper at level 25. Route 103 is reached in C02.

party.role: primary rain-boosted physical Water attacker with single-target Ground coverage
party.availability: Mudkip from the Mauville Game Corner (500 coins, C18), Marshtomp at 16, Swampert at 36 which the cap-36 window allows.

party.role: Huge Power priority and item removal; Assault Vest survives the special Fire attackers
party.availability: Marill on the Petalburg City old-rod table (gate 14, Old Rod given in C02), evolves at level 18.

party.role: Rock-type wall immune to burn; Salt Cure grinds the bulky Fire members down
party.availability: Altering Cave 1F rock-smash table (gate 30); Rock Smash license is granted in Mauville (C18), before Mt. Chimney and Lavaridge.

party.availability: Magikarp on the Petalburg City old-rod table (gate 14), evolves at level 20.

party.role: redirection and Helping Hand support with 60-percent flinch pressure
